Name: Name
areas_info: Draw the area on the map, as a polygon or a circle, or choose a German county. It is computed when the configuration is saved, and again and again by its CRON pattern.
distance_help: Traps farther from the route are not counted (1 to 100 m)
port_help: The map widgets of vis-2 load the routes and areas from this port of the instance
profile_help: How the route goes: "with traffic" avoids slowdowns of the current traffic
routes_info: A route is computed when the configuration is saved, and again and again by its CRON pattern. The instance must run for that.
style_help: For the maps of this configuration. The Mapbox styles need the token.
token_help: Needed to compute the routes. The maps and the search for addresses work without it, with OpenStreetMap.
